name: Weather Timeline Pro
description:
See the next 24 hours as one readable weather timeline on your XENEON Edge.

• Large layouts show the full 24-hour forecast; compact layouts page between the first 12 and next 12 hours.
• Tap an hour for feels-like temperature, precipitation amount, wind speed/direction, and UV.
• Save up to three locations and switch them from the display.
• See sunrise, sunset, civil dawn, and civil dusk in the timeline, plus a concise three-day overview on larger layouts.
• Choose from eight themes.

Forecasts are cached per widget instance, so a temporary provider failure leaves the last successful forecast readable with a clear stale indicator.

Setup: choose your locations and preferences in iCUE. Weather access uses iCUE when available; if your iCUE build does not provide it, you can add your own free WeatherAPI.com key as a local fallback.

Compatibility: CORSAIR XENEON Edge. Pro focuses on forecast depth and does not include alerts or an air-quality panel in V1.

Made by PackRat.
release_notes: Initial Pro release. 24 hour timeline, richer precipitation, wind speed and direction, feels-like temperature, UV, three saved locations with touch switching, three day overview, civil dawn and dusk context, eight themes, rich touch hour details, cached stale-data fallback, and all eight XENEON Edge layouts.
